additional_info.subject: RE: ID0408113-DC/SiD/FR [Y2 / R4 312555359102] Charger Unavailable CRM:00251000479
additional_info.body:
Hi
DSC France,
Thanks for the quick response. We have checked the OCPP connectivity for the last 3 hours' timestamps, and there hasn't been a single instance of OCPP connection loss. However, we did observe that the connection was lost yesterday, possibly due to a network issue at the site for longer time. We had requested remote access to the charger and will check the router configuration for any abnormalities. Please allow us some time, and we will get back to you shortly.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0408113-DC/SiD/FR [Y2 / R4 312555359102] Charger Unavailable CRM:00251000479
additional_info.body:
Hi
DSC France,
We have accessed the charger remotely, and while checking the OCPP router WebUI, we noticed two mobile connections in the WAN configuration. We have corrected this, and the OCPP is now online again. There shouldn't be any issues related to the router configuration unless there's a network provider issue. We just need to release the E-Stop button, and the charger will be operational again.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
